reapack.desc: REAPER Notator 3.3: Native Musical Notation & Engraving Suite

metadata.description: REAPER Notator 3.3 (Exclusive Edition) — Proprietary native musical notation, score editing, and engraving environment for Cockos REAPER. Requires ReaImGui v0.10+ and Reaticulate. Includes Master Acoustic Studio VST3 ('Notator Acoustic Master', supported on Windows x64 and macOS Universal2 only — Linux not supported). Copyright (C) 2026 A-intheCode. All Rights Reserved.

version.author: A-intheCode
version.changelog: + v3.3: Integrated Notation-Safe Piano Roll: Dual-Reality Played Durations (Shift+Drag Pre-Roll & Legato Tail Ghost-Halos + Humanizer with 0% score/MusicXML impact), Draw-Hold-Drag auto-lengthening, Grid Razor Split (✂) & Same-Pitch Heal/Glue Brush, Scale Check ('Out-of-Scale Red'), Percussion Drum Map sidebar, Multi-Track Stencils & Smart-Lock, Top Bar View/Note-Coloring menus (incl. Sub-Beat Rests), and updated v3.3 Manual + v3.2.3: Linked multi-staff transposition (Ctrl+A + Key & Chords, EN/DE/FR), MusicXML chord import, collapsible Score Tools, taller Chord & Rehearsal lanes, and updated v3.2.3 Manual + v3.2.2: Hotfix Record Caching + v3.2.1: Record Mode Performance Hotfix: Fix 'Live Note Preview on Canvas while Recording' toggle (strictly zero canvas notes, zero mid-recording MediaItems, and 0.0ms silent-canvas cache reuse when unchecked while preserving 100% of recorded notes, Auto-Divisi, Full Ensemble Fill & CCs on Stop), fix 1-Bar Recording Pre-roll punch-in session sync, batch multi-track bar commits inside PreventUIRefresh, bypass mid-recording full-project item/hash scans, add O(1) incremental live-bar engraving & monotonic active-bar width stabilization for stutter-free Smooth Auto-Scroll, and update User Manual to v3.2.1 + v3.2: Major Feature & Engine Update: Master Acoustic Studio ('Notator Acoustic Master' 64-bit VST3 with 1-click zero-UAC/zero-sudo auto-installer, 8-Point TPT-SVF Graphical EQ, Dynamic Concert Mastering & Anti-Click Lookahead Limiter — supported on Windows x64 & macOS Universal2; greyed out on Linux with 'Linux not supported' tooltip), Tempo-Mapped Audio Wave Tracks & Audio-to-MIDI transcription, Multilingual UI (English / Deutsch / Français) & Studio Dark/Light UI themes, 1-Bar Non-Overlapping Live Recording Engine with syncopation extension, Stop-only Auto-Voice, 60-FPS 16-track gmem preview & true playable instrument ranges, expanded MusicXML (.musicxml / .xml / .mxl) importer with Elaine Gould Grand Staff slur & orchestral clef autodetection, dedicated Notator vs. REAPER update checker, and updated v3.2 User Manual + v3.1: Major Feature & Engine Update: Massive upgrade of Melodic Pathfinder (Orchestra, Guitar & Bass, and Percussions / Drums modes, Reference Profile blending, dedicated Select Notes marquee mode, Merge Selected Notes / Overridden Note locks, and Note Length Multiplier — see Manual for details), plus improvements for Hairpins & Crescendos and Articulation Switching + v3.01: Update & Hotfix: Add multilingual '• Dot (×1.5) [.]' toggle button in the Left Sidebar under Note Values (toggles augmentation dot on selected notes or for new note input), exact grid-aligned MIDI note durations (0-tick gap on repeated same-pitch notes in Write Notes [D] & Step Input, 0-tick overlap on Slurs), chord slur target pitch resolution, and independent chord note & slur deletion + v3.0: Major Exclusive Release: REAPER Notator 3.0 — Protected Closed-Source Binary Core Architecture, Multi-Staff Engraving, Synthesizer V Studio Pro 2 Live Bridge, Automatic Articulation Negative Delay Scanner, Guitar/Bass Tablature, Melodic Pathfinder 2.0, Circle of Fifths & 1,500 Orchestral Patterns
